items.title: Edwin "Squirrel" Ashcraft Interview, 1961-08-16

ctx.x: Nobody of any consequence. I think the only one that was known afterwards at all was Chug Champlin, who played a whole lot of different instruments. Phil Thompson, who played the banjo. Abbie Barker. Well, as a matter of fact, many of them, because Chicago is quite a Dartmouth town, went to Dartmouth and were part of the Dartmouth-Barberi Coast.
